notes: CDER website-review letter (no facility inspection): compounded retatrutide is charged as an unapproved new drug and misbranded (505(a), 502(f)(1)) because it fails the 503A/503B bulk-substance conditions, while compounded semaglutide and tirzepatide are charged only with false/misleading advertising under 502(a)/502(bb) (implying equivalence to FDA-approved Mounjaro/Ozempic/Wegovy/Rybelsus). Classified 'compounding' (matching the nativemed-llc-dba-nativemed / healthy-male precedent for this 503A/503B letter template) but, unlike those precedents, unapproved_new_drug is also included because retatrutide is formally charged under section 505(a)/301(d), not just a compounding-exemption failure. 'MOUNJARO' is excluded from products since it is quoted only as a misleading marketing claim referencing a competitor's approved drug, not the firm's own product name. is_sterile_product is true given the explicit discussion of injectable delivery risk (bypassing the body's defenses via bloodstream injection). No FEI/location_contains since this is a website review only.
